visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up tracking shot of a man in a black tank top walking down a wooden staircase. He has a blue plastic dental floss pick held between his lips and maintains a calm, neutral facial expression with his eyes looking forward. The background is a brightly lit hallway with white walls and warm wood accents. (2) As the man enters a cluttered room, the camera pans to show two women in the distance standing near a refrigerator, looking distressed with their hands raised. The man ignores them and approaches a wooden shelving unit, crouching down to move various containers and boxes. The room is filled with household clutter, including cardboard boxes and storage bins. (3) The man reaches into a lower shelf and picks up a large, dark-colored insect, which appears to be a cockroach. He holds it steadily between his thumb and forefinger, showing it to the camera while maintaining his calm demeanor. A young boy in a light blue shirt enters the frame, looking up at the man and the object with a curious, slightly confused expression. (4) The man suddenly thrusts the insect toward the women in the background. They react with dramatic physical movements, flinching and turning away quickly. The man then tilts his head back and opens his mouth wide in a laughing gesture, while the dental pick remains in his mouth. The video ends with the man's joyful and triumphant expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the rhythmic thudding of footsteps on a wooden surface. In the far distance, faint, high-pitched female screams are audible, though muffled by the acoustic environment. There is no background music during this phase. (2) A sudden increase in volume occurs as female screaming becomes sharp and distinct. The sound of rustling plastic and the metallic clinking of objects being shifted on a shelf follows. A male voice speaks in a calm, conversational tone with low pitch variability. (3) A new phase is triggered by the start of a bouncy, major-key electronic meme track featuring a female singer repeating 'Happy'. The male voice raises in volume and arousal, complaining about the noise level. A child's high-pitched voice utters a short 'Huh?' with a rising intonation. (4) The track reaches an acoustic peak with an explosive, high-arousal female scream. This is immediately followed by a male's loud, rhythmic belly laughter. The music and background vocalizations collide in a chaotic, high-energy mix before the audio track concludes with a final burst of laughter.
